dedupe_keys.name: hydrological model continuum hmc core of the flood proofs forecasting system

description: The Hydrological Model Continuum (HMC) is a distributed hydrological model produced by the CIMA Research Foundation and used operationally by the Italian Civil Protection Department and international partners. It is the computational core of the Flood-PROOFS system for flood forecasting and nowcasting, hydrogeological risk prevention, water resource management and climate simulations, operational in Italy, Bolivia, Albania and Lebanon. It simulates surface and subsurface flow, snow with an energy balance, soil moisture, groundwater and channel routing by grid or indexed schemes, in a Fortran implementation with NetCDF input and output. Coverage is any basin set up on a grid. Version 3.4.2 (April 2026) is on GitHub under the EUPL-1.2. Caveats: documentation lives in the repository README and changelog, and a set-up needs gridded basin data and forcing. Simulation uses: operational flood forecasting and discharge scenarios for flood defence and reservoir operation studies. Related records: HYPE (model-smhi-hype-hydrological-model) and wflow (model-wflow).
